title: perfcached
description: perfcached nodes: traffic, collections, durability (WAL + snapshots), cluster, memory, pub/sub.

options.content:
#### perfcached  ·  found fast, kept safe
Every chart is one series the daemon exports on `/metrics`; hover the ⓘ on a panel for the daemon's own description of the number.  Red means an operator should look: a FAILED WAL, a stalled cluster thread, an invalid map, refused writes, or snapshots that cannot keep up with the WAL.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description:
`perfcached_uptime_seconds` - seconds since startup

Instances answering the scrape.

panels.title: Commands / s
panels.description: `perfcached_command_calls_total` - commands executed, by name: RESP under its Redis name, the native doors as json.<verb> and bin.<verb> (S159)

panels.title: Client hit ratio
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_client_hits_total` - read hits from client workers only

`perfcached_collection_client_misses_total` - read misses from client workers only

Client lookups only - a peer's pull is not a client hit (S151).

panels.title: Entries
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_entries` - live records

Summed over the selected nodes: with replication a key held on K nodes counts K times.

panels.title: Clients open
panels.description: `perfcached_clients_open` - client connections open across the data doors (S161)

panels.title: Arena headroom (min)
panels.description: `perfcached_arena_headroom_ratio` - free share of the ceiling

panels.title: Writes refused / s
panels.description: `perfcached_writes_refused_total` - writes refused, arena full

panels.title: WAL dropped (range)
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_dropped_total` - records dropped, ring full

Any non-zero value is acknowledged writes lost - the node FAILS itself.

panels.title: WAL storage failed
panels.description: `perfcached_wal_storage_failed` - the device refused a WAL write or sync (node FAILED until restarted)

panels.title: Cluster thread stalled
panels.description: `perfcached_cluster_thread_stalled` - the cluster thread has made no progress for apply_stall_ms (the node reports STALLED)

panels.title: Map invalid
panels.description: `perfcached_cluster_map_valid` - the map is usable

panels.title: Arena at ceiling
panels.description: `perfcached_arena_at_ceiling` - 1 while carves are being refused at the ceiling

panels.title: Epoch refusals (range)
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_epoch_refused_total` - peer datagrams refused for speaking another wire epoch

A node on an incompatible wire epoch tried to join or keep alive (S221).

panels.title: Healing now
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_healing` - 1 while a heal runs (writes refused, reads served)

`perfcached_wal_heals_total` - times the node healed lost WAL records with a snapshot and returned to service

S229: a node whose WAL lost acknowledged writes refuses writes, serves reads, and takes a snapshot that makes them durable; it returns by itself. Usually well under a second.

panels.title: Snapshots behind the WAL
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_full_in_seconds` - how long the free segments last at the current fill rate (-1 = not measured)

`perfcached_rdb_last_duration_seconds` - how long the last completed snapshot took (0 = none yet)

Nodes whose free WAL segments last less than twice their last snapshot (RV-12). Brief blips under a burst are the trigger doing its job; alert on it HOLDING.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_wire_epoch` - the cluster wire contract this build speaks

One row per node.  A version or epoch that differs from its neighbours is a mixed fleet.

panels.title: Commands / s by node
panels.description: `perfcached_command_calls_total` - commands executed, by name: RESP under its Redis name, the native doors as json.<verb> and bin.<verb> (S159)

panels.title: Top commands / s
panels.description: `perfcached_command_calls_total` - commands executed, by name: RESP under its Redis name, the native doors as json.<verb> and bin.<verb> (S159)

panels.title: Latency p99 by command (top 8 by traffic)
panels.description:
`perfcached_command_latency_seconds` - per-command latency, four buckets per octave from 1 us up

Worker execution time, from the daemon's own histogram (four buckets per octave).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cmd) (rate(perfcached_command_latency_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cmd) topk(8, sum by (cmd) (rate(perfcached_command_calls_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency: mean vs p50 / p99 (all commands)
panels.description:
`perfcached_command_usec_total` - microseconds the workers spent executing them

`perfcached_command_latency_seconds` - per-command latency, four buckets per octave from 1 us up

panels.title: Latency distribution (all commands)
panels.description: `perfcached_command_latency_seconds` - per-command latency, four buckets per octave from 1 us up

panels.title: Connections by door and dialect
panels.description: `perfcached_connections_open` - connections open now, by door and dialect

panels.title: Clients vs the limit
panels.description:
`perfcached_clients_open` - client connections open across the data doors (S161)

`perfcached_max_clients` - the client limit in force

`perfcached_clients_refused_total` - connections refused at the limit

panels.title: Unknown commands / s
panels.description:
`perfcached_commands_unknown_total` - commands this node answered as unknown or unsupported, by dialect (S165)

`perfcached_commands_unknown_preauth_total` - unknown commands before AUTH - counted, never named

A client speaking a verb the daemon lacks - usually a Redis command not implemented yet.

panels.title: Entries by collection
panels.description: `perfcached_collection_entries` - live records

panels.title: Client hit ratio by collection
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_client_hits_total` - read hits from client workers only

`perfcached_collection_client_misses_total` - read misses from client workers only

panels.title: Hits and misses / s (client)
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_client_hits_total` - read hits from client workers only

`perfcached_collection_client_misses_total` - read misses from client workers only

Misses drawn below the axis.

panels.title: Peer lookups / s (all minus client)
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_hits_total` - read hits

`perfcached_collection_misses_total` - read misses

Lookups that reached the table from peers (pulls, reconcile probes): all lookups minus the client's.

panels.title: Memory by collection
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_held_bytes` - key and value bytes of the records held, from the maintenance thread's paced walk

`perfcached_collection_record_bytes` - the records held as the cells they occupy (class-rounded), from the walk

`perfcached_collection_index_bytes` - index regions carved for the collection's table (creation and growth), never freed

panels.title: Index overflow and held-bytes walk
panels.description:
`perfcached_collection_overflow` - records in the overflow leg rather than in a bucket's slots

`perfcached_collection_held_walk_seconds` - duration of the last held-bytes walk, which every other maintenance duty waits behind

panels.title: Node state
panels.description:
`perfcached_node_state` - the node's lifecycle state: 1 for the current one

Green is READY. Amber is a transient state - HEALING (S229), STALLED, RECOVERING, STARTING, DRAINING. Red is FAILED.

panels.title: Heals
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_heals_total` - times the node healed lost WAL records with a snapshot and returned to service

`perfcached_wal_last_heal_seconds` - how long the last heal took (0 = none yet)

`perfcached_wal_healing` - 1 while a heal runs (writes refused, reads served)

A heal means the WAL could not keep up and lost acknowledged writes from the log, which a snapshot then made durable. Now and then under a burst is the backstop working; often means the rings, the storage or the load need resizing.

defaults.noValue: no heals - the WAL has kept up (or the node predates rc36)

panels.title: WAL records / s
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_appended_total` - records written to the WAL

`perfcached_wal_dropped_total` - records dropped, ring full

panels.title: WAL fill rate
panels.description: `perfcached_wal_fill_mb_per_second` - how fast the WAL ring is filling (smoothed, decays while idle)

panels.title: Snapshot race: WAL time-to-full vs 2 x last snapshot
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_full_in_seconds` - how long the free segments last at the current fill rate (-1 = not measured)

`perfcached_rdb_last_duration_seconds` - how long the last completed snapshot took (0 = none yet)

The RV-12 rule, drawn: when the solid line dips under its dashed partner the WAL asks for the next snapshot.  Staying under means snapshots run back to back with no margin - give the WAL more segments, raise rdb_mb_s, or shed load.

defaults.noValue: nothing to race yet: the WAL has not filled a segment since the node started (time-to-full is measured from the first rotation), or the node predates rc33

panels.title: Snapshots
panels.description:
`perfcached_rdb_last_duration_seconds` - how long the last completed snapshot took (0 = none yet)

`perfcached_rdb_in_progress` - a snapshot is being written now

defaults.noValue: needs perfcached 0.4.0-rc33 or later (the snapshot series arrived with RV-12)

panels.title: Time since the last snapshot
panels.description:
`perfcached_rdb_last_success_age_seconds` - seconds since the last completed snapshot (-1 = none yet)

Resets at every completed snapshot; a line that only climbs means snapshots have stopped.

defaults.noValue: needs perfcached 0.4.0-rc33 or later (the snapshot series arrived with RV-12)

panels.title: Snapshots / h and failures
panels.description:
`perfcached_rdb_saves_total` - snapshots completed and published by this process

`perfcached_rdb_save_errors_total` - snapshots that failed or could not be made durable, and so were not published

defaults.noValue: needs perfcached 0.4.0-rc33 or later (the snapshot series arrived with RV-12)

panels.title: WAL backlog
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_staged_records` - acknowledged writes not yet in the log file (lost on kill -9)

`perfcached_wal_unsynced_records` - records in the log file not yet fsynced (lost only to power loss)

`perfcached_wal_last_seq` - newest sequence number

`perfcached_wal_synced_seq` - newest fsynced sequence

panels.title: WAL device refusals
panels.description:
`perfcached_wal_storage_failed` - the device refused a WAL write or sync (node FAILED until restarted)

`perfcached_wal_control_errors_total` - CONTROL writes or syncs the device refused

defaults.noValue: none - every node's WAL device is accepting its writes and syncs

panels.title: Replication applied / s
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_rx_applied_per_second` - replica records applied per second

`perfcached_cluster_rx_older_per_second` - replica copies refused as older per second

`perfcached_cluster_rx_drops_per_second` - datagrams dropped per second

Rate gauges are computed since the LAST reader - a second scraper halves them. The *_total counters below are exact.

panels.title: Replication totals / s (counters)
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_rx_applied_total` - replica records applied

`perfcached_cluster_rx_drops_total` - datagrams the receive buffers could not hold

panels.title: Peer receive queue vs socket buffer
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_rx_queue_bytes` - bytes waiting in the cluster receive queues

`perfcached_cluster_rx_rcvbuf_bytes` - the effective receive buffer

panels.title: Cluster thread health
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_thread_stall_max_ms` - the longest stall seen

`perfcached_cluster_thread_stalls_total` - times the cluster thread was found stalled

`perfcached_cluster_thread_stalled` - the cluster thread has made no progress for apply_stall_ms (the node reports STALLED)

panels.title: Repair sweep
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_repl_sweep_ms` - wall time of the last completed eager repair cycle

`perfcached_cluster_repl_sweep_scanned` - records the last repair cycle walked

`perfcached_cluster_repl_sweep_sent` - records the last repair cycle sent

`perfcached_cluster_repl_sweep_cycles_total` - completed repair cycles

Last completed cycle's duration (left), and what it scanned and re-sent (right).

panels.title: Reconcile after an outage
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_reconcile_pending` - reconcile probes issued and not yet answered

`perfcached_cluster_reconcile_ms` - wall time of the last completed post-restart reconcile pass, first probe to last

`perfcached_cluster_reconcile_skipped` - the reconcile was skipped: no peer was up while this node was down

A returning node probes what it holds against live peers.  SKIPPED = no peer was up long enough before it died to vouch for a delete (S223): it keeps everything.

panels.title: Membership
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_nodes` - nodes in the published map

`perfcached_cluster_replicas_short` - replicas minus live members, 0 when met (S157)

`perfcached_cluster_map_valid` - the map is usable

panels.title: Wire epoch
panels.description:
`perfcached_cluster_wire_epoch` - the cluster wire contract this build speaks

`perfcached_cluster_epoch_refused_total` - peer datagrams refused for speaking another wire epoch

panels.title: Arena: held, live and the ceiling
panels.description:
`perfcached_arena_held_bytes` - memory held from the host

`perfcached_arena_live_bytes` - bytes in live records

`perfcached_arena_max_bytes` - the configured ceiling

panels.title: Headroom
panels.description: `perfcached_arena_headroom_ratio` - free share of the ceiling

panels.title: Committed, reserved, locked
panels.description:
`perfcached_arena_committed_bytes` - bytes of the reservation committed - the initial commit plus every 2 MB group a carve reached, less what the give-back punched; RSS follows this

`perfcached_arena_reserved_bytes` - the address space reserved for the arena: the cap

`perfcached_arena_locked_bytes` - bytes of the arena locked in RAM (mlock); 0 = the arena is swappable

`perfcached_arena_page_slack_bytes` - alignment slot of every shm page; regions + class chunks + warm free + page slack = held

panels.title: Where held memory sits
panels.description:
`perfcached_arena_class_chunk_bytes` - chunks the size classes own (live records inside, free cells that belong to the class)

`perfcached_arena_regions_bytes` - index regions held (bucket directories, hint tables, counters - carved at creation and on growth, given back when a table is retired)

`perfcached_arena_warm_free_bytes` - free slots kept resident

`perfcached_arena_regions_free_warm_bytes` - retired index slots kept resident (inside warm_free)

`perfcached_arena_regions_free_cold_bytes` - retired index slots punched out (inside cold)

panels.title: Arena commits / s
panels.description:
`perfcached_arena_commits_inline_total` - 2 MB groups a carve had to commit itself - the write path populating with a client waiting (S166)

`perfcached_arena_commits_ahead_total` - 2 MB groups committed ahead of the chunk frontier by the reclaim tick

`perfcached_arena_commits_index_total` - 2 MB groups committed by a region carve - a table split on the maintenance thread, or a collection created (S168)

`perfcached_arena_region_reuse_total` - index carves served from retired slots instead of the frontier

`perfcached_arena_regions_retired_total` - index slots given back by retired tables

panels.title: Give-back to the OS
panels.description:
`perfcached_reclaim_released_bytes_total` - memory given back

`perfcached_reclaim_tail_released_bytes_total` - the reservation's never-carved tail given back (inside released_bytes)

`perfcached_reclaim_shrink_step_bytes` - the most give-back one tick may do

panels.title: Give-back calls and blockers
panels.description:
`perfcached_reclaim_punch_calls_total` - madvise calls that punched memory out, one per run

`perfcached_reclaim_punch_groups_total` - 2 MB groups those calls covered

`perfcached_reclaim_giveback_disabled` - give-back latched off

`perfcached_hugetlb_pool_empty_total` - punched groups not re-committed, pool empty

`perfcached_arena_pin_lost` - 1 = a group could not be locked after a pinned start: the arena is partly swappable (S167)

panels.title: Writes refused / s
panels.description: `perfcached_writes_refused_total` - writes refused, arena full

panels.title: Published and delivered / s
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_published_total` - messages published here, own and relayed

`perfcached_pubsub_delivered_total` - frames delivered to local subscribers

`perfcached_pubsub_keyspace_events_total` - keyspace notifications emitted on this node (PS8)

panels.title: Subscriptions
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_subscribers` - subscriptions held by connections on this node

`perfcached_pubsub_channels` - channels with at least one local subscriber

`perfcached_pubsub_patterns` - patterns with at least one local subscriber

panels.title: Subscriber queues
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_queue_bytes` - bytes queued for workers right now

`perfcached_pubsub_queue_dropped_total` - messages dropped because a worker's queue was at its cap

`perfcached_pubsub_slow_kills_total` - subscribers closed at the output cap

`perfcached_pubsub_publish_paused_total` - publishing connections paused because a worker queue they feed passed half its cap

`perfcached_pubsub_alloc_failed_total` - deliveries not made because an allocation failed on this node

panels.title: Fleet relay / s
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_relay_sent_total` - messages relayed to peers

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_recv_total` - messages received from peers

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_skipped_total` - relays not sent because the peer's interest ruled them out

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_duplicates_total` - relayed datagrams that arrived twice and were dropped

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_lost_total` - relay sequence gaps seen

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_dropped_total` - publishes too large for a datagram, delivered locally only

panels.title: Relay path and peers
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_relay_sent_path_total` - relays sent, by path

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_peers_direct` - peers that answered on their relay port and receive relays there

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_peers_filtered` - peers relayed only what matches their interest

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_peers_broadcast` - peers that filter but are sent everything until their interest is current here

`perfcached_pubsub_relay_rx_threads` - threads reading pub/sub relays on their own port (0 = the cluster socket)

panels.title: Relay datagrams and interest
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_relay_rx_datagrams_total` - datagrams read by the relay receive threads

`perfcached_pubsub_udp_datagrams_total` - deliveries sent as sealed datagrams

`perfcached_pubsub_interest_updates_total` - first-subscription updates, by direction

`perfcached_pubsub_interest_resyncs_total` - full interest states, by direction

panels.title: UDP streams and their losses
panels.description:
`perfcached_pubsub_udp_streams` - connections receiving pub/sub pushes over UDP, probing or confirmed

`perfcached_pubsub_udp_expired_total` - streams never confirmed

`perfcached_pubsub_udp_oversized_total` - deliveries too large for a datagram, sent over TCP

`perfcached_pubsub_udp_send_errors_total` - datagrams the socket refused

`perfcached_pubsub_udp_pruned_total` - streams pruned, their connections' subscriptions dropped, by reason
